parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human JAK3 (CHEMBL2148). Use the full provenance path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2148 and standard_type IC50. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
